newsitem.title: USA: Duke sees Oconee nuke units up in Jan/Feb.
newsitem.headline: Duke sees Oconee nuke units up in Jan/Feb.

text.p: Duke Power Co said Thursday its Oconee nuclear units 1 and 2 would likely restart in mid-January, while Oconee 3 was expected to return to service in late January or early February.
The 846 megawatt (MW) Oconee 2 nuclear unit was shut Sept 24 after a steam pipe burst in the non-nuclear part of the unit.
Seven workers were scalded in the accident, four of them critically.
Units 1 and 3, each with a capacity of 846 MW, were subsequently shut for inspections.
Duke Power has a total generating capacity of about 18,500 MW, of which the Oconee plant accounts for about 14 percent.
